import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,datetime
p=Path.cwd()
def w(n,o):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(o,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
before=json.loads((p/'frozen-before.json').read_text());after=json.loads((p/'frozen-after.json').read_text());assert not before['mismatches'] and not after['mismatches']
s=json.loads((p/'SUMMARY.json').read_text());s['frozen_after']='frozen-after.json: PASS, all12 immutable bindings';s['hash_manifest']='SHA256-MANIFEST.json: terminal artifact';w('SUMMARY.json',s)
excluded={'SHA256-MANIFEST.json':'Manifest cannot hash itself noncircularly','terminal_manifest.receipt.json':'Runner writes this receipt only after manifest-generating child has exited; explicitly excluded terminal generation receipt','terminal_manifest.output.txt':'Runner writes stdout only after manifest-generating child exits; contains manifest digest, so excluded from manifest'}
files=[]
for q in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if not q.is_file():continue
 name=str(q.relative_to(p))
 if name in excluded:continue
 b=q.read_bytes();files.append({'path':name,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
completed_receipts=[x['path'] for x in files if x['path'].endswith('.receipt.json') or x['path']=='bootstrap-receipt.json']
manifest={'created_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Every current own-lane file including every completed receipt JSON, source payload/text, plans, denials, immutable helpers, reservation, before/after frozen verification, inventories, proofs and handoff, except precisely named noncircular terminal exclusions','exclusions':excluded,'completed_receipts_included':completed_receipts,'frozen_after_pass':True,'acceptance_credit':0,'files':files}
w('SHA256-MANIFEST.json',manifest)
for e in files:assert hashlib.sha256((p/e['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==e['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'SHA256-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'manifest_files':len(files),'completed_receipts_included':len(completed_receipts),'frozen_before_after':'PASS12/12 each','qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0,'terminal_exclusions':list(excluded),'jobs':'All synchronous child jobs reaped; terminal runner will reap this child before writing excluded receipt/output'}))
